# Martin Tile Server Documentation

> Martin is a fast tile server that serves vector and raster tiles from PostGIS, PMTiles, MBTiles, COG, GeoJSON and DuckDB, along with sprites, fonts and styles.

Martin is a tile server and a set of tools able to generate vector tiles on the fly from large
PostgreSQL databases, and serve tiles from PMTiles, MBTiles, Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF, GeoJSON and
DuckDB files. It can combine multiple tile sources into one, and also serves sprites, fonts and
MapLibre styles. It is written in Rust and optimized for speed and heavy traffic.
The `martin-cp` tool generates tiles in bulk, and the `mbtiles` tool inspects, copies, diffs,
patches and validates MBTiles archives.

## Configuration

- [Configuration](<https://maplibre.org/martin/config-file/index.md>): The configuration file format and global options
- [Tile Sources](<https://maplibre.org/martin/sources-tiles/index.md>): Overview of the supported tile sources
- [MBTiles and PMTiles File Sources](<https://maplibre.org/martin/sources-files/index.md>): Serving tiles from MBTiles and PMTiles files
- [MBTiles File Sources](<https://maplibre.org/martin/sources-mbtiles/index.md>): MBTiles file source options
- [PMTiles File Sources](<https://maplibre.org/martin/sources-pmtiles/index.md>): PMTiles file source options, including remote and S3 archives
- [PostgreSQL Connections](<https://maplibre.org/martin/pg-connections/index.md>): PostgreSQL connection settings and auto-publishing
- [PostgreSQL Table Sources](<https://maplibre.org/martin/sources-pg-tables/index.md>): Serving PostGIS tables and views as vector tiles
- [PostgreSQL Function Sources](<https://maplibre.org/martin/sources-pg-functions/index.md>): Serving tiles generated by PostgreSQL functions
- [Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF File Sources](<https://maplibre.org/martin/sources-cog-files/index.md>): Serving raster tiles from Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF files
- [GeoJSON Sources](<https://maplibre.org/martin/sources-geojson/index.md>): Serving GeoJSON files as vector tiles
- [DuckDB Sources](<https://maplibre.org/martin/sources-duckdb/index.md>): Serving tiles from DuckDB databases and GeoParquet files
- [Passthrough Sources](<https://maplibre.org/martin/sources-passthrough/index.md>): Proxying tiles from an upstream HTTP tile server
- [Composite Sources](<https://maplibre.org/martin/sources-composite/index.md>): Combining multiple sources into one tile
- [Tile Grids](<https://maplibre.org/martin/tile-grids/index.md>): Tile grids and tile matrix sets
- [Postprocessing](<https://maplibre.org/martin/postprocessing/index.md>): Transforming tiles after they are read from a source
- [MVT/MLT Conversion](<https://maplibre.org/martin/postprocessing/mlt/index.md>): Converting between MVT and MapLibre Tiles (MLT)
- [Hillshade](<https://maplibre.org/martin/postprocessing/hillshade/index.md>): Generating hillshade tiles from elevation data
- [Contours](<https://maplibre.org/martin/postprocessing/contour/index.md>): Generating contour lines from elevation data
- [Sprites](<https://maplibre.org/martin/sources-sprites/index.md>): Serving sprites generated from SVG icons
- [Style Sources](<https://maplibre.org/martin/sources-styles/index.md>): Serving MapLibre styles
- [Server-side raster tile rendering](<https://maplibre.org/martin/sources-styles/rendering/index.md>): Rendering styles to raster tiles on the server
- [Fonts](<https://maplibre.org/martin/sources-fonts/index.md>): Serving font glyphs generated from font files
